name: Comment keyword to DM
oneLiner: a glass comment box springs in, the keyword types in caps letter by letter, send is pressed with a ring and a paper plane flies off, then a DM pops back from the creator carrying a link card to the resource
say: on the call to action, 'comment GUIDE and I'll send it to you': the keyword types as they say it, the DM with the link lands on 'send it to you'
